desc: Raindrop spirit: translucent blue droplet body with a gold crown of water crests. Face: two big glossy sparkly oval eyes with white highlights, rosy cheeks, tiny mouth. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
